# Decision 1 readiness: trans-continental manuscript & meridian congress
oe_syn_meridian_congress_ready = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			oe_syn_press_count_at_least_2 = yes
			OR = {
				oe_syn_has_any_afr_milestone = yes
				oe_syn_has_any_amr_milestone = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			oe_syn_press_count_at_least_1 = yes
			OR = {
				oe_syn_is_meridian_hub_holder = yes
				oe_syn_is_quito_meridian_actor = yes
				owns = location:tenochtitlan
				owns = location:qusqu
			}
		}
	}
}
